title: DebianSourceReportV1
description:
The §18 comprehensive `DebianSourceReportV1`.

In the RED commit, the struct is the minimal shape: the §17 tri-state plus the candidate identity and the first-entry changelog block. The GREEN commit extends the struct with the §18 sub-structs (`source_metadata`, `binary_packages`, `source_format`, `patches`, `tests`, `watch`, `gbp`, `maintainer_scripts`, `rules`).

candidate_commit.description: The candidate's Git commit OID. Carried per §18 (lines 842-846) so the report is candidate-bound.

candidate_fingerprint.description: The candidate the tool was invoked against.

candidate_tree.description: The candidate's Git tree OID. Carried per §18 (lines 842-846).

diagnostics.description: Per-check failure / informational lines. Empty when `verdict` is `pass`.

identity.description: The first-entry identity from `debian/changelog`, extended in 1C.2 with `maintainer` and `timestamp`.

schema_version.description: Always `1` for this revision. Bump on incompatible wire-format changes.

ChangelogIdentity.description:
The first-entry identity block from `debian/changelog`.

1C.2 extends this with `maintainer` and `timestamp` (the closing-paren trailer's `Maintainer:` and `Date:` lines). Both new fields are `Option<String>` so a changelog whose trailer is malformed still parses (the report's `diagnostics` carries the `E_CHANGELOG_TRAILER_MALFORMED` line; the verdict aggregates it).

maintainer.description: The trailer's `Maintainer:` line, e.g. `IronMaint Test <test@example.invalid>`. `None` when the trailer has no `Maintainer:` field.

timestamp.description: The trailer's `Date:` line, in the RFC 2822 form `dpkg-parsechangelog` emits (e.g. `Thu, 09 Oct 2026 00:00:00 +0000`). `None` when the trailer has no `Date:` field.

Diagnostic.description: A single failure or informational line from the tool.

code.description: A stable, machine-readable error code, e.g. `E_DEBIAN_DIR_MISSING`. Future tools can match on this without parsing the message.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. The tool does not embed the offending value (a) to keep PII out of the report and (b) so the same diagnostic text can serve any fixture.

path.description: The on-disk path that triggered the diagnostic, when applicable (e.g. `debian/`, `debian/changelog`).

oneOf.description: At least one §17 check failed (mismatched name, mismatched version, unparsable `debian/control`, unparsable `debian/changelog`, missing `debian/`, unidentifiable source format, unparsable mandatory metadata). Diagnostics list the specific failure.

The tool could not establish the fact at all: the workspace path is unreadable, an IO error occurred, a parser binary is missing. The §17 rule "parser binary missing → InfrastructureError" lives here.
